notes: Owner's manuals: ownersmanual.audiusa.com redirects to the global portal ownersmanual.audi.com. 'Select with VIN' covers MY2008+; 'Select by model' (region 'USA and Canada', language en_US) needs no VIN but only offers MY2018+ (catalog from GET /web/models/). It yields an ONLINE HTML manual: the start link /web/nar/start-tnr?tnr={part no}&language=en_US creates an anonymous session (web_access_token cookie) and opens /app/nar/; no stable PDF URL exists - in model-selection sessions /nar/res/v1/pdf/available returns {available:false}. Edition lists (release date + part number) were retrieved for A3 (MY2018-2026) and A4 (MY2018-2025) only: the site is protected by AWS WAF and after ~17 automated listing requests (7 s apart) it returned HTTP 405 and showed a CAPTCHA dialog; per policy the CAPTCHA was not solved and collection stopped (A5/A6/Q3/Q5/Q7 editions -> not_found with reason). Only the A4 MY2019 start link (8W0012721BK) was opened and confirmed; other start links are API-listed but not opened. One manual per model family: A3 covers S3/RS 3, A4 covers S4/A4 allroad, A5 covers S5/RS 5, A6 covers S6/RS 6, Q5 covers SQ5, Q7 covers SQ7 (the US catalog has no separate S/RS model ids). Free PDFs (no VIN): Audi USA Warranty and Maintenance booklets and Maintenance schedule cards per model year from maintenance.audiusa.com (Select Model Year/Model/Trim), served as stable UUID links on ownersliterature.vw.com (Volkswagen Group of America, importer 444, brand A); verified by GET (server ignores Range) reading only the first 1 KB.
